goals: Enable end users to browse a list of posts sourced from Gist
Enable end users to open and read a single post with Markdown rendered correctly
Use Gist as the sole source of truth for post content

userStories.title: View List of Posts
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see a list of posts so that I can choose what to read.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Posts are fetched from a configured Gist (or Gist collection)
Each list item shows at least: title and a short preview or date
List is ordered (e.g. by date, newest first)
Clicking an item navigates to the full post view

userStories.title: Read a Full Post
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to open and read a full post so that I can consume the content.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Full post content is loaded from the corresponding Gist file
Markdown is rendered as HTML (headings, lists, code blocks, links, etc.)
User can return to the list (e.g. back link or navigation)

functionalRequirements.description: ** The app fetches post metadata and content from GitHub Gist API.
** Post content is stored as Markdown in Gist files.
** The app renders Markdown to HTML for display.
** A configurable Gist ID (or list of IDs) defines the post source.
** Posts have a title (from Gist filename or frontmatter) and body content.
